title: Moses Flees to Midian
description: Moses kills an Egyptian who is mistreating a Hebrew and must flee from Pharaoh to Midian. There he helps the priest's daughters at the well, marries Zipporah, and has a son named Gershom.

versions.title: Moses Flees to Midian
versions.description: Moses kills an Egyptian and flees to Midian, where he marries Zipporah and becomes a shepherd.
versions.reason: [minor] references: Verses 23-25 serve as a bridge to the next story (God hears Israel's cry). It could be considered concluded at verse 22, but verses 23-25 can also be defended as the conclusion of Moses' time in Midian.
